title: Fent Hub Auto Everything
features:
Home: Discord join, supported-executors list, server dashboard.

Summon: banner select, amount, summon delay, fast summon, teleport-to-summon, auto summon, summon once, summon-until-rarity (multi), summon-until-unit (multi).

Reroll: unit select (multi), stop-at-trait (multi), auto trait reroll, reroll selected.

Shop: Gold / Raid / Event / Music / Tournament item dropdowns, refresh items, buy selected, auto buy.

Equip: equip best units.

Macro: record, stop, clear, replay now, export/import team (clipboard), auto replay, auto upgrade.

Queue: category, map, act, difficulty, private party, auto join, launch map, auto launch.

In-Game: auto skip wave, auto next, auto repeat stage, force restart, auto start game, auto return to lobby, auto click, auto skip rewards, low detail.

Rewards: claim all quests, auto-claim (quests / calendar / events / group / battlepass / milestones / index), craft targets, auto craft.

Session: anti-AFK, server hop, rejoin, auto rejoin on disconnect, teleport persistence, rejoin hourly, scheduled disconnect.

Performance: hide map, disable 3D render, FPS limit.

Webhook: URL, test, ping on rarity, on summon, on match, AFK log + send now.

Config: auto save, named save, load (dropdown), export/import (clipboard), unload.
